prompts.prompt: Use case: ads-marketing. Asset type: English open-source project campaign concept illustration, landscape. Primary request: A sophisticated editorial illustration for ToolCrop, a tool-use dataset recipe that checks actual execution. Show a row of beautiful paper instruction cards flowing through a small transparent mechanical test rig; some cards emerge as sturdy green building blocks, others are neatly diverted as amber paper slips. This is a conceptual metaphor, not software UI or a measured chart. Style: tactile paper sculpture, precise isometric engineering, dark navy background, mint green and warm amber accents, soft studio light, generous negative space. Text verbatim: 'ToolCrop' and beneath it 'Plausible is only the start'. No other text, no logos of other brands, no numbers or statistics, no testimonials. Clean readable English typography.
